body:
Part of the **Veles OTP external devices** RFC execution plan (OTP-08).

Backgrounded connector keeps receiving event-driven native transport without short throttled timers; synthetic automatic-copy succeeds through a clipboard-only offscreen document. Includes service-worker observation of `chrome.tabs.onUpdated` `frozen`/`discarded` transitions and `onRemoved`, immediate per-tab badge/status invalidation, and port-generation invalidation before freeze/discard recovery. Ten-minute background scenario with no timer-throttling exemption; forced freeze/discard recovery with fresh host and bounded queues.

**Full task specification:** see section `### OTP-08` in the RFC: docs/rfcs/2026-08-21-otp-external-devices.md (PR #79) — https://github.com/raidenyn/veles-android/pull/79

## OTP-23 carried-forward verification obligations


Tracking amendment from the post-grant review of #86 / PR #123 (baseline `cab043885ffe1991a6f3037c69a768ed6acbcd00`). These checklists assign future implementation/retest ownership; they do **not** mark a test PASS, waive a requirement, change dependencies, or authorize OTP-24. The current OTP-23 decision remains NO-GO until an explicit owner-approved gate amendment or satisfaction of its criteria. Only new-account W-01/M-01/M-02 are waived as nonblocking NOT RUN. Preserve earlier failed evidence and stable signing identities.

### Current-harness background and recovery evidence
- [ ] Adopt only an explicitly owner-approved background acceptance interpretation from #86. Keep Native Messaging's intrinsic timer exemption separate from artificial keepalive/audio/WebRTC/launch-flag exemptions; no silent rewrite of the RFC's current wording.
- [ ] Run COLD (no prior record exchange) and PREWARM as separate >=600 s scenarios on both Windows and macOS using the current harness and production-shaped host/connector. Require unsolicited byte-exact records from two phones, uninterrupted hidden/unfocused connector and visible/focused ordinary-tab histories, no CDP client during idle, clean flags and actual launch/harness provenance.
- [ ] Capture current foreground-gate evidence for macOS: old 14-check PASS adjudications lack the later ST-15 field and current re-evaluations are BLOCKED. Preserve both; do not re-label historical files to manufacture current acceptance.
- [ ] Independently test freeze/discard/removal, fresh-port/host recovery and queue bounds; successful idle delivery does not establish a discard/freeze exemption.
- [ ] Record evaluator revision, source hashes and explicit operator phone-source bindings, with conservative clock uncertainty. A harness observational PASS is not formal acceptance by itself.
Retain the existing offscreen clipboard and service-worker requirements. Signed-package combined validation remains in #94.
title: OTP-08: Establish background liveness and offscreen clipboard support
